_comment: Branch protection config applied to main of every MiraNote-AI repo. Fully hardened: (1) `restrictions` empty-allowlist blocks direct push to main; (2) `required_status_checks` enforces `checks / checks` -- a PR with a red check cannot merge; (3) `enforce_admins: true` removes owner bypass -- the `--admin` flag is rejected by GitHub, so every PR truly needs an approving reviewer (a different human from the author, since GitHub disallows self-approval). For emergencies, temporarily set `enforce_admins: false` and rerun this script; restore after.
